justification: ECON-OOS4 three-period split applied 2026-05-08. Full sample = 6783 trading days (2000-01-03 to 2025-12-31). Step 1: Carve holdout from chronological end. 252-day minimum for daily credit class; 2025-01-01 is the first trading day of 2025, yielding 261 holdout trading days (>= 252 minimum). Remaining sample = 2000-01-03 to 2024-12-31 (6522 obs, ~299 months). Step 2: Apply ECON-OOS2 formula to remaining 299 months: validation_span = min(max(36, round(299 * 0.25)), 120) = min(max(36, 75), 120) = 75 months. Validation start = 2024-12-31 minus 75 months = approximately 2018-09-30; first actual trading day at or after = 2018-10-01. IS end = 2018-09-28. Step 3: IS = 2000-01-03 to 2018-09-28 (4890 obs); Validation = 2018-10-01 to 2024-12-31 (1632 obs); Holdout = 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (261 obs). HMM leakage check (ECON-T4): original HMM IS end = 2017-12-31 <= new IS end 2018-09-28. No refitting required; signals parquet reused. Prior split (Wave 5C retro-apply) used a two-period design with oos_start=2018-01-01. Declared divergence per META-XVC: three-period split shrinks the validation window (2088 obs -> 1632 obs) but adds a clean 261-day holdout sealed throughout the tournament. Winner is unchanged (S6_hmm_stress / T4_hmm_0.5 / P2 / lead=0) per the three-period tournament re-run.
